Maryland Department of State Planning State Office Building 301 West Preston Street Baltimore, Maryland 21201
SUBJECT: PROJECT SURFARY MOTIFICATION REVIEW

Project: . Off-Road Vehicles - Use on Public Lands

CHECK GME
1.
This agency does not have an interest in the above project.
The above project is consistent with this agency's plant or objectives and we recommend approval of the project.
3. This agency has further interest in and/or questions concerning the above project and wishes to confer with the applicant.

Cur interest or questions are shown on enclosed attachment.
4. This agency does not believe a conference is necessary, but wishes to make favorable or qualifying comments shown on enclosed attachment. XXX
The review of this project in the Department of Natural Resources resulted in generally favorable response from all member agencies. The Department wishes to be kept informed of regulations as they are developed by the Bureaus of the Department of the Interior, since Maryland will be promulgating regulations for the use of Off-Road Vehicles to be applied within lands owned or under the control of the Department of Natural Resources.
Title Chief. Planning & Evaluation
